title: Gauge Launch Week
summary: Five launches in five days, from November 2 to November 6. This post links to every launch as it goes live.
body_markdown:
Welcome to our first ever launch week at Gauge! We've been shipping at a breakneck pace, so we thought we'd take a beat to share with the world what we've shipped.


We'll be updating this post throughout the week as launches... launch!


Keep an eye out for the videos we're posting on socials, and make sure to test out each of the new features. We'll be giving away 100 Gauge Agents credits to every customer that uses each feature on launch day with a grand prize of 500 credits for using every feature during the week. That's a total of 1,000 credits for just using Gauge!*


## November 2: Gauge Optimizations


Improve how coding agents use your product by A/B testing changes to your documentation, CLI, MCP, and Skills.


Optimizations let you rewind a coding agent session to the exact tool call where it went wrong and test what would fix that issue.


[Read the launch →](https://www.withgauge.com/blog/launch-week-optimizations)
